added.statement: EndOffsetForJustify is the offset ComputeTrailingSpaceWidth's walk stops at: the walk goes back over the line's item results, skips items opaque to collapsing (tags), passes results that are only trailing spaces, and stops inside the last text before its hanging spaces, so preserved trailing spaces before a box end aren't justified; without preserved trailing spaces it is InflowEndOffset
tests: src/engines/blink/lines.test.ts :: justify ends before preserved trailing spaces that lie across a box end (line_info.cc:289-415)

tests: src/engines/webkit/lines.test.ts :: a span in two places on a reordered line: only its first display box is its first box (computeIsFirstIsLastBox)

added.statement: the string a port hands to measureText reaches Canvas as the port built it: measure/canvas.ts never uses it as a Map, Set or property key, since V8 internalizes a key, stores an internalized string in one byte when its units fit and turns the looked-up string into a reference to it, which made canvasString's two-byte slice a one-byte string that Canvas shapes as one Latin segment; width and bounds hand it to measureText as it is, and nothing stores an answer by its string

tests: src/measure/canvas.test.ts :: always ask Canvas and use no key

added.statement: a segmented paragraph measures its one-byte strings on contexts of their own, made when the first is asked, so no canvas is asked a string or a word in both storages: Chrome keeps the strings and words a canvas shaped under their characters and direction, whatever the storage, and the first shaping answers both; an unsegmented paragraph's strings are two-byte by their characters alone and Canvas cuts no words from them, so it keeps one set
tests: src/engines/blink/lines.test.ts :: a segmented paragraph asks its one-byte and its two-byte strings on contexts of their own
src/engines/blink/lines.test.ts :: an unsegmented paragraph keeps one set of contexts

added.statement: a range the paragraph shapes as Latin that holds a space, a character other than white space, no soft hyphen and no character with a script of its own is measured as an 8-bit string with U+0020 itself, in a font Canvas shapes whole: U+2028 would make the string 16-bit and RunSegmenter would resolve its characters as Common over the string alone, where the 8-bit string is one item shaped as one Latin segment, as the paragraph shapes it; a font shaped word by word keeps U+2028 and script-context
tests: src/engines/blink/lines.test.ts :: a Latin range of script-neutral characters keeps its spaces as U+0020 in a font shaped whole
